purpose: Record-level preservation and reinterpretation crosswalk for the legacy A–F reference collection. This manifest preserves citation metadata and source-qualified aliases without restoring legacy finding text, causal claims or parameters. It is an intake and review layer, not an active evidence register.

source_archive.note: Legacy finding strings are intentionally not copied here. The referenced Git blob preserves the historical wording for audit; active interpretation is only the bounded manifest fields below.

manifest_contract.active_registry_rule: Only active-registry records may support the current FieldState–ASFR route. A migration record never becomes a parameter, coefficient or active causal claim merely by appearing here.
manifest_contract.legacy_pathway_label_rule: Legacy A–F/T labels are provenance labels, not unqualified canonical node IDs. Their historical namespace is resolved only through the qualified legacy compatibility adapter.
manifest_contract.empty_canonical_nodes_rule: An empty canonical_nodes list is deliberate for sources outside the active graph. It prevents a forced, unsupported causal attachment.

status_definitions.SUPERSEDED_BY_ACTIVE_RECORD: Exact bibliographic alias of a separately curated active FieldState record.
status_definitions.MIGRATION_CANDIDATE: Potential node-relevant source requiring source-level protocol and claim review before activation.
status_definitions.CONTEXT_ONLY: Retained for endpoint, covariate, ecological or alternative-context use; not an active causal input.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL_CONTEXT: Retained for provenance or theory history; not a current measurement-qualified inference.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED_CITATION: Legacy citation is incomplete, placeholder-like or otherwise requires independent bibliographic verification before use.
status_definitions.OUTSIDE_ACTIVE_GRAPH: Preserved citation has no safe attachment to the current graph; forced mapping would create a new unsupported edge.
